assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated.
The study is for extended ambulatory assessment to characterize arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate documented arrhythmia burden in a patient with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
